latest_update.text: Salam, We reviewed the site with Hoda on 9/25 and wants this round of changes delivered by this week . Keep the page by page approach and protect existing rankings. Add to cart: open a drawer/sidebar with an animation so shoppers stay on the page and can add several items before checkout. Homepage: move the Meet Your Butcher video above the meats section, use video as the hero background, and cut the cooked meat slicing clip . Copy: replace "humanely raised" with "domestically raised" or "raised on family farms"; drop "farm" from the poultry, lamb and goat category titles; remove "we never outsource" but keep the USDA inspected facility line; replace "always fresh" with "vacuum sealed and frozen at peak freshness".
